A second 34-record supplement covers 39 additional public video, documentation, code and risk sources; five materially distinct leads add queue rows M247-M251 and the rest map to existing aliases. A further bounded primary-source MEXC pass adds six unregistered mechanics-based proposals from seven enumerated official pages, with related aliases and explicit pending allocations. A bounded library pass adds10 catalog entrypoints and one pinned Dynamic Breakout II method; directories are not fully ingested. One follow-up code audit pinned a third-party Dynamic Breakout II reproduction; its deviations and formula defect remain source-only, without outcomes. A bounded official QuantInsti pass enumerates nine distinct rules/controls/allocation variants from three pinned received files; only two no-regret methods are synthetically executed. No strategy outcome or new canonical method is added.
